notes.title: January Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone who's already playing or is going to play I am Weapon:Revival!
A new update has now been published.
In the last few months we've collected a lot of game statistics and now we significantly rebalanced the gameplay.
The update also includes:
- Slight changes on game levels. 
- Performance improvements
- Minor bug fixes.
Have fun playing!

notes.title: It’s a plane…. It’s a bird… It’s our super release!
notes.notes: Hello everyone! The co-op mode is finally ready, which means the full version of IAWR is up and running! That wasn’t easy, and we’re still keeping an eye on things just in case. Thanks for your support! Please share!

notes.title: Update 31 May
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Great news, guys! We’re putting some finishing touches on IAW before the release. All the levels are completed, the content is ready, which is why we’re making the rest of the game available, all but the last battle. We’re going to keep it till the final release for which we’ll add the co-op mode. And you’ll be able to check it out yourselves just in a couple of weeks’ time!
 
[h1]In today’s update:[/h1][list]
[*]8 new levels
[*]9 new achievements
[*]New OST (more tracks are coming soon)
[*]New SFX added when you kill frozen enemies
[*]Dead zones settings for gamepad available[/list]
 
[b]Gameplay:[/b][list]
[*]Hit chance when using the axe increased
[*]Enemies respawn only at certain location points
[*]Overall game balance improved[/list]

 
[b]Improvements:[/b][list]
[*]Game objects causing lags when loading now optimized
[*]Overall optimization improved[/list]
